$ aid container --help
Usage: aid container [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  build  Build a container image from a Containerfile
  list   List running dev containers
  stop   Stop and remove a dev container
  help   Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -q, --quiet  Suppress informational output (only errors/warnings shown). Also set via AID_QUIET=1
  -h, --help   Print help

$ aid store --help
Usage: aid store [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  browse   Browse available agents in the store
  install  Install an agent from the store (publisher/name)
  show     Show agent TOML from the store (publisher/name)
  update   Check for updates to installed store packages
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -q, --quiet  Suppress informational output (only errors/warnings shown). Also set via AID_QUIET=1
  -h, --help   Print help

Examples:
  aid store browse
  aid store install sunoj/aider
  aid store show sunoj/aider

$ aid byok --help
Manage BYOK providers (custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints) via opencode

Usage: aid byok [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  apply    Apply a BYOK manifest: patch opencode config + auth and generate the matching aid agent
  remove   Remove a BYOK provider by manifest path or provider id
  probe    Probe an OpenAI-compatible endpoint to confirm it emits tool_calls
  example  Print a canonical example BYOK manifest (MiMo) to stdout
  doc      Print the BYOK pattern documentation to stdout
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -q, --quiet  Suppress informational output (only errors/warnings shown). Also set via AID_QUIET=1
  -h, --help   Print help

Examples:
  aid byok apply examples/byok/mimo.toml --dry-run
  aid byok apply ./mimo.toml
  aid byok probe ./mimo.toml
  aid byok remove mimo
  aid byok example > my-provider.toml
  aid byok doc | less

$ aid byok apply --help
Apply a BYOK manifest: patch opencode config + auth and generate the matching aid agent

Usage: aid byok apply [OPTIONS] <MANIFEST>

Arguments:
  <MANIFEST>  Path to the BYOK manifest TOML

Options:
      --dry-run    Print the plan and exit without modifying any files
  -q, --quiet      Suppress informational output (only errors/warnings shown). Also set via AID_QUIET=1
      --key <KEY>  API key override (else uses manifest api_key or key_env)
  -h, --help       Print help

$ aid byok remove --help
Remove a BYOK provider by manifest path or provider id

Usage: aid byok remove [OPTIONS] <TARGET>

Arguments:
  <TARGET>  Manifest path OR provider id (e.g. mimo)

Options:
  -q, --quiet  Suppress informational output (only errors/warnings shown). Also set via AID_QUIET=1
  -h, --help   Print help

$ aid byok probe --help
Probe an OpenAI-compatible endpoint to confirm it emits tool_calls

Usage: aid byok probe [OPTIONS] <MANIFEST>

Arguments:
  <MANIFEST>  Path to the BYOK manifest TOML

Options:
      --key <KEY>  API key override (else uses manifest api_key or key_env)
  -q, --quiet      Suppress informational output (only errors/warnings shown). Also set via AID_QUIET=1
  -h, --help       Print help

$ aid finding --help
Usage: aid finding [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add     Post a finding to a workgroup
  list    List findings for a workgroup
  get     Show a single finding for a workgroup
  update  Update review metadata for a finding
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -q, --quiet  Suppress informational output (only errors/warnings shown). Also set via AID_QUIET=1
  -h, --help   Print help

$ aid finding add --help
Post a finding to a workgroup

Usage: aid finding add [OPTIONS] <GROUP> [CONTENT]

Arguments:
  <GROUP>    Workgroup ID
  [CONTENT]  Finding content

Options:
  -q, --quiet                        Suppress informational output (only errors/warnings shown). Also set via AID_QUIET=1
      --stdin                        
      --file <FILE>                  
      --task <TASK>                  Source task ID (optional)
      --severity <SEVERITY>          
      --title <TITLE>                
      --finding-file <finding-file>  
      --lines <LINES>                
      --category <CATEGORY>          
      --confidence <CONFIDENCE>      
  -h, --help                         Print help

$ aid finding list --help
List findings for a workgroup

Usage: aid finding list [OPTIONS] <GROUP>

Arguments:
  <GROUP>  Workgroup ID

Options:
      --json                 
  -q, --quiet                Suppress informational output (only errors/warnings shown). Also set via AID_QUIET=1
      --count                
      --severity <SEVERITY>  
      --verdict <VERDICT>    
  -h, --help                 Print help

$ aid group --help
Usage: aid group [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  create     Create a workgroup
  list       List workgroups
  show       Show one workgroup and its member tasks
  update     Update a workgroup name and/or shared context
  delete     Delete a workgroup definition
  cancel     Cancel all non-terminal tasks in a workgroup
  summary    Summarize workgroup results with milestones, findings, costs
  finding    Post or list workgroup findings
  broadcast  Send a message to the workgroup's broadcast channel
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -q, --quiet  Suppress informational output (only errors/warnings shown). Also set via AID_QUIET=1
  -h, --help   Print help
